findings.text: the node edited a file outside its four declared write paths, removing the autouse fixture that cleared _SETTLED_IDENTITIES and the pytest import only it used; the edit is required once the memo is retired, since logs/arm-head.log shows those tests failing at setup at a4b72a5ff5, but the fence was never widened, so a change the node needs arrives outside the scope it was granted.

the filed baseline_suite command and measurement_module name /tmp/arm-20261114-2zw6y3on, a tree no log under logs/ records, while the arm-base.log it cites ran in /tmp/arm-20261114-pbv53l3e; after_suite cites the in-worktree gate-head.log rather than the matched scratch arm arm-head-scratch.log, so the base and head arms cannot be reconciled as a matched pair from the receipt alone.

tuple(int(item) for item in identity) is unguarded while _document_is_usable at :2074 never checks the shape of directory_identity, so a document the module calls usable but whose identity holds a non-numeric value now raises ValueError out of _persist_index_document on a reader's reconcile path, where the same document previously only cost a re-listing.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against ffcba667: a4b72a5ff5 adds the stamp helpers, the 208-line test and retires the memo; 41256d10e0 routes the stamp through read_cache_document/write_cache_document and deletes the reader test's memo-clearing fixture; d89c36e124 and 4d0372b434 record the fragment; 350 insertions and 33 deletions across four files, one of them outside the fence.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names tests/test_an_unchanged_reconcile_writes_only_its_stamp.py; logs/gate-head.log records 56 passed EXIT=0 at 4d0372b434 against 53 passed, 2 errors EXIT=1 at ffcba667 in logs/arm-base.log, logs/repro-base-second-process-lists-once.log shows the same test red at the base revision, and logs/negative-control.log shows the declared mutation red with "an unchanged reconcile rewrote the index document" EXIT=1.
item_verdicts.goal: the node goal is "Record the review store's identity in a small stamp so an unchanged reconcile writes only the stamp"; reckon/crew/review_records.py:1938 adds _index_stamp_path with _read_index_stamp, :1968 adds _persist_index_stamp, :1987 adds _index_is_settled, and reconcile_foreign_write:2291 now advances only the stamp when nothing changed, with the in-process _SETTLED_IDENTITIES memo retired (grep for that name at the head revision returns 0 hits).
item_verdicts.manifest: read in full; it records status complete, the gate command and its result, a baseline/after suite pair with per-failure attribution and a per-dimension rubric self-check, but its commits list names three shas where the diff carries four, and its baseline_suite command and measurement_module name a /tmp tree that the arm-base.log it cites did not run in.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the fence declares reckon/crew/review_records.py, tests/test_an_unchanged_reconcile_writes_only_its_stamp.py, the node's fragment and docs/figures/the-monitor-reads-each-fact-once/review-index-stamp-s49; three of the four paths in the diff are inside that set and tests/test_a_review_index_reader_never_waits_or_rewrites.py is outside it, which the manifest records under outside_scope.

justifications.durability: tests/test_an_unchanged_reconcile_writes_only_its_stamp.py:180-185 fails when an unchanged reconcile rewrites the document and :186 fails when a freshly started process lists the store at :192, which logs/repro-base-second-process-lists-once.log shows happening at base, and :195 pins the probe to the fixture's own entry count as a positive control rather than to anything the test passes to the code under test.
justifications.evidence: logs/gate-head.log (56 passed, EXIT=0) and logs/arm-base.log (53 passed, 2 errors, EXIT=1) carry both arms with their revisions, but the manifest's baseline_suite command and measurement_module name /tmp/arm-20261114-2zw6y3on while the arm-base.log they cite ran in /tmp/arm-20261114-pbv53l3e, so the filed receipt cannot be matched to its own log.
justifications.fit: reckon/crew/review_records.py:1938-2010 follows the module's private-helper and cache-document idiom and introduces no plan, phase or ticket label in any name, docstring or comment.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/review_records.py:2378 persists the settled identity through _persist_index_stamp and :2417 consults it through _index_is_settled, so a reconcile that changes no entry writes only stamp.json beside index.json.
justifications.reuse: reckon/crew/review_records.py:1957 and :1981 delegate to read_cache_document and write_cache_document, the module's existing owners of a cache document, though the added _index_is_settled at :1987 is a second notion of a settled store identity beside recovery_memo.py:416's persisted directory identities.
justifications.scope_discipline: tests/test_a_review_index_reader_never_waits_or_rewrites.py:22 was changed outside the four declared write paths, disclosed in the manifest's outside_scope and needed once the memo it cleared was retired.
